aggregation: Median three fresh runs within geometry/method/scale, then ratios within identical geometry and scale, then split medians. Scales and timing repeats do not increase the 32 independent geometries.

decision.note: The primary coarse-solve plus single-refinement pipeline fails the frozen cost-only gate. Do not replace it with a secondary method or claim learned acceleration.

independent_checks: historical geometry identities and coefficient fingerprints
saved-score deterministic budget decoder including fallback
matched proposal scores and chosen cells
recorded convergence, energy, residual and repeat flags
limits: No PDE solver or numerical experiment module is imported.
Raw coefficient arrays and coarse solution fields are not persisted; score formula values are not regenerated.
Full solution fields are not persisted; their hashes cannot reconstruct energy norms, residuals, or field agreement.
All repetitions retain solver/residual/error validity summaries; full repeated fields, selected meshes and energies are not persisted, so their determinism remains a frozen runner check.
Independent sparse-assembly equivalence is established by frozen numerical tests, not reconstructed by this report.
